markets.rules_primary: If Atlanta, Georgia ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras after Issuance and before Feb 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A jurisdiction ends its use of Flock Safety cameras if its governing body, chief executive, or police department:

terminates a Flock Safety contract before the contract's scheduled end date, or
declines to renew or extend a Flock Safety contract, or declines to allow an automatic renewal to take effect, or
allows a Flock Safety contract to reach its scheduled end date without entering a renewal or replacement agreement, or
otherwise discontinues the jurisdiction's use of Flock Safety cameras, including by moving to a different license plate reader vendor.

The action must occur on or after August 21, 2026, and be reported before February 1, 2027.

The following do NOT count:

Renewing or extending the contract, even with added privacy safeguards, audit requirements or use restrictions
A temporary pause, camera deactivation, or moratorium that leaves the underlying contract in force and does not prevent its renewal
A non-binding resolution, advisory referendum or committee recommendation that the official empowered to act has not acted upon

Each jurisdiction is judged on its own, and action by a jurisdiction not named in this event does not affect any market here.

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
markets.title: Will it be reported by a Source Agency that Atlanta, Georgia ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras before Feb 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If a New York State court issues an order prohibiting, suspending, or pausing the opening or operation of at least one planned New York City municipal grocery store in Multicultural Business Coalition v. City of New York, Index Nos. 160693/2026 and 160694/2026, or a proceeding formally related to, consolidated with, transferred from, renumbering, succeeding, or reviewing either named matter and concerning the same requested relief before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The ruling must:
Be issued by a New York State court in Multicultural Business Coalition v. City of New York, Index Nos. 160693/2026 and 160694/2026, or a proceeding formally related to, consolidated with, transferred from, renumbering, succeeding, or reviewing either named matter and concerning the same requested relief
Address the matter described by the specified judgment
Be issued through a written order, opinion, judgment, or decision

A temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, permanent injunction, or other written relief qualifies if it has the operative effect of prohibiting, suspending, or pausing the opening or operation of at least one planned New York City municipal grocery store. Partial relief affecting only one planned store is sufficient. A temporary restraint contained only in an order to show cause does NOT qualify; the restraint must be issued through a separate qualifying written order, opinion, judgment, or decision.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Draft opinions that leak but are not officially issued
Settlements or voluntary dismissals
Administrative or scheduling orders
Orders to show cause
Minute orders that do not address the substantive issue in the specified judgment

For clarity:
Sua sponte rulings count if they match the specified judgment
Per curiam opinions and summary orders count as rulings
If multiple judges issue separate opinions, the majority/plurality opinion controls
markets.title: Will a court halt an NYC municipal grocery store before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.rules_primary: If a bill establishing a minimum wage of at least $30 per hour for New York City set to go in effect 2030 or earlier has become law in New York City before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law. For standard legislation requiring executive approval, this includes final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods. For legislation not requiring executive approval, this includes final passage and completion of required waiting periods. For constitutional amendments, this includes passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes. For executive orders, this includes official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness. Legislative passage without completed executive action, passage by only some required bodies, provisional passage, non-binding resolutions, and draft orders do not constitute enactment. Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

markets.rules_primary: If María Corina Machado has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of Venezuela before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.
markets.title: Will María Corina Machado visit Venezuela before Jan 1, 2027?
